title: Tickwire system configuration v1
description: Design contract. TOML is parsed into this JSON data model. Source candidates have no _materialization. ProcessProjection and ProjectionObject define independent permission-scoped runtime representations. x-change-class is a conservative family default; field rules and semantic checks in configuration.md are mandatory.

cluster_scope.description: Explicit cluster-wide scope for this role. Requires an empty account_ids array; an empty array alone grants no scope.

x-semantic-checks: CFG-S01 unique IDs, references, process roles and account risk-domain ownership
CFG-S02 finite JSON-safe integers; decimal strings; no TOML datetime, float, unresolved placeholder or source _materialization
CFG-S03 logical strategy <=1 Active plus <=1 Shadow; combined instance and subscription budgets
CFG-S04 ring power-of-two, ABI record sizes, actual arena class allocation and all resources <= host SHM budget
CFG-S05 CPU and NUMA inventory, exclusive hot-loop cores, physical and OS-identity containment
CFG-S06 replica failure domain differs from source; voters span three failure domains; no control-only order WAL
CFG-S07 heartbeat and renewal < respective lifetime; election/replication/disk thresholds ordered
CFG-S08 account/product/modes and signed venue metadata, fees, tiers, budgets and entitlements match
CFG-S09 live forbids fixture/.invalid/REQUIRED; resolves immutable artifacts and authorized secret refs; validates complete deployment manifest
CFG-S10 strategy parameters validate pinned parameter schema; restricted type registry determines Hot versus Quiesce
CFG-S11 no unreferenced identities or secret material; secure endpoint allowlist, namespace/environment consistency
CFG-S12 plans bind whole base ETag, target membership, desired hash, qualification and classification; semantic revalidation at commit/apply
